CustomField.description: Developer name of an EmailTemplate to use for this reminder, overriding the EmailTemplate__c set on the parent ScheduledAlert__mdt record. Leave blank to use the ScheduledAlert's template.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the DeveloperName of the EmailTemplate to use. Leave blank to fall back to the ScheduledAlert's EmailTemplate__c.
CustomField.label: Override Email Template
